title: uCT analysis parameters

parameters.name: Patella volume
parameters.definition: Mineralized patellar volume; inclusion of the separate proximal ossification needs review.
parameters.method: Count accepted patellar label voxels × voxel volume. Current core excludes label 12.

parameters.name: Lateral meniscus / osteophyte volume
parameters.definition: Volume of the lateral mineralized meniscal / osteophyte structure shown on slide 1.
parameters.method: Existing lateral joint mineralization (label 6) is a candidate only. Confirm anatomy, boundaries and inclusion before calling this meniscus/osteophyte volume.

parameters.name: Medial meniscus / osteophyte volume
parameters.definition: Volume of the medial mineralized meniscal / osteophyte structure shown on slide 1.
parameters.method: Existing medial joint mineralization (label 5) is a candidate only. Confirm anatomy, boundaries and inclusion; unmineralized meniscus is not recovered by this bone threshold.

parameters.name: Distal femoral length (DFL)
parameters.definition: Straight 3D distance from midpoint (a) of the upper groove boundary to intercondylar notch (b).
parameters.method: Explicitly trace the upper groove boundary and its midpoint, then locate the posterior notch. Original A/C endpoints are shown for comparison, not newly validated a/b placements.

parameters.name: Distal femoral width (DFW)
parameters.definition: Midpoint (c) of the ridge on the lateral condyle surface to the vertex (d) of the medial condyle.
parameters.method: Re-identify ridge midpoint and medial vertex in multiple views. Original L/M extremes on W=0 do not establish these anatomical landmarks; old ruler shown only for review.

parameters.name: Distal femoral width / length
parameters.definition: DFW divided by DFL using accepted slide-1 landmarks.
parameters.method: Recalculate after parameters 4 and 5 are accepted. Existing ratio is derived from prior, unvalidated placements.

parameters.name: Medial subchondral plate thickness
parameters.definition: Thickness of the medial subchondral bone plate beneath the articular surface.
parameters.method: Separate plate from cortical shell, trabeculae, growth plate and outgrowths; define medial ROI and thickness method before computing a local-thickness distribution.

parameters.name: Lateral subchondral plate thickness
parameters.definition: Thickness of the lateral subchondral bone plate beneath the articular surface.
parameters.method: Define lateral plate boundaries and a comparable ROI; report thickness method and summary statistic. Do not substitute trabecular thickness.

parameters.name: Secondary ossification center: total volume (TV)
parameters.definition: Total tissue volume of the tibial secondary ossification center bounded by articular surface and growth plate.
parameters.method: Create an anatomical tissue mask including bone and internal spaces, with explicit growth-plate exclusion. The whole tibia label is not this ROI.

parameters.name: Secondary ossification center: bone volume (BV)
parameters.definition: Mineralized bone volume inside the secondary ossification center tissue ROI.
parameters.method: Apply the agreed calibrated threshold within parameter 9 ROI; count bone voxels × voxel volume.

parameters.name: Secondary ossification center: BV/TV
parameters.definition: Bone volume divided by total tissue volume in the same secondary ossification center ROI.
parameters.method: 100 × parameter 10 / parameter 9. Preserve both masks and threshold provenance.

parameters.name: Tibial height at secondary ossification center
parameters.definition: Articular-surface to growth-plate height. Slide 2 illustrates both maximal height and local compartment heights.
parameters.method: Record maximum IIOC height separately from medial and lateral local heights. Existing lateral V195 height is related evidence only and is not substituted for this parameter.

parameters.name: Tibial width at growth plate
parameters.definition: Distance between tibial medial and lateral borders at the growth-plate level.
parameters.method: Review orientation, section and anatomical border placements. Slide 2 illustrates a slanted growth-plate-level line; it does not require a shared transverse plane. The previous junction chord remains unaccepted because its endpoints and correspondence to the illustrated borders need review.

parameters.name: Tibial height / width
parameters.definition: Accepted tibial height divided by accepted width at the growth plate.
parameters.method: State which height is used (maximum, medial or lateral); do not mix a local lateral height with an unvalidated junction chord.

parameters.name: Trabecular ROI tissue volume (TV)
parameters.definition: Tibial shaft trabecular ROI begins 50 µm distal to the growth plate, extends 200 µm, and stays 20 µm inward from the endocortical boundary. Growth-plate datum and cortical mask still need definition.
parameters.method: Count all tissue-mask voxels, including marrow spaces. At 10.5 µm spacing the requested offsets are 4.76, 19.05 and 1.90 voxels; document physical-distance sampling.

parameters.name: Trabecular ROI bone volume (BV)
parameters.definition: Mineralized bone volume within the slide-3 trabecular tissue ROI.
parameters.method: Threshold HU inside the accepted parameter-15 mask. Exclude cortex and growth plate; preserve the bone mask.

parameters.name: Trabecular ROI BV/TV
parameters.definition: Bone fraction within the same slide-3 tissue ROI.
parameters.method: 100 × parameter 16 / parameter 15; report threshold and voxel spacing.

parameters.name: Trabecular number (Tb.N)
parameters.definition: Trabecular number per unit length within the slide-3 ROI.
parameters.method: Choose and document a direct 3D or specified model-based method. Do not silently substitute skeleton branch count or 1/Tb.Th.

parameters.name: Trabecular thickness (Tb.Th)
parameters.definition: Thickness distribution of segmented trabecular bone inside the ROI.
parameters.method: Use a validated 3D local-thickness method and define ROI-edge handling. Two times the distance transform at each voxel is not a complete local-thickness implementation.

parameters.name: Trabecular separation (Tb.Sp)
parameters.definition: Spacing of marrow spaces between trabeculae inside the ROI.
parameters.method: Apply a documented spacing method to the marrow compartment, with ROI-boundary handling and voxel-resolution assessment.

parameters.name: Trabecular nodes (Tb.Nd)
parameters.definition: Junctions where three or more trabecular branches meet; slide 3 labels this a developing parameter.
parameters.method: Define a skeleton/graph method, merge adjacent junction voxels, specify pruning and exclude artificial ROI-cut junctions. A voxel-neighbor count is not a node count.

parameters.name: Trabecular ends / termini (Tb.Tm)
parameters.definition: Free endpoints of the trabecular graph; slide 4 discusses a node-to-end ratio.
parameters.method: Count degree-1 graph endpoints after declared pruning. Distinguish genuine termini from branches cut by the ROI boundary; define zero-denominator behavior for any derived ratio.

parameters.name: Cortical thickness
parameters.definition: Cortical shell thickness below the growth plate; slide 3 asks about 100 µm versus 500 µm locations.
parameters.method: Keep both candidate locations listed until the user selects a level. Define periosteal/endosteal contours, section or slab thickness and thickness statistic before measuring.

vertebral.definition: Slide 5 repeats parameters 15–23 for vertebral trabecular bone and mid-vertebral cortical thickness. No vertebra is present in OA6-1RK; a separate vertebral dataset and ROI are required.

notes: Slide 6 is blank. Slide 7 contains illustrative images without additional numbered parameters.
The presentation defines target measurements, not accepted sample results. Existing measurements retain their original provenance.
The cortical 100 µm and 500 µm locations remain candidates; neither has been accepted.

derived.name: Trabecular node-to-end ratio (Tb.Nd/Tb.Tm)
derived.definition: Accepted trabecular graph node count divided by accepted terminus count in the same ROI.
derived.method: Requires parameters 21 and 22, a declared graph/pruning/boundary method, and a zero-denominator policy. Do not interpret as a validated OA/osteoporosis severity cutoff.
